topology.sample_unit: one forecast window (10 history frames, 20 future frames) of one simulated pitching case
topology.independent_unit: simulated case (one pitching kinematics); all windows of a case stay in one split

partitions.0: train.npz: cases over the (k, theta0) design region minus a held-out block
partitions.1: validation.npz: cases inside the held-out block k in [5.5, 6.5], theta0 in [24, 32] deg, which straddles the periodic to aperiodic transition

topology.source: Organizer-generated 2D incompressible simulations of a pitching NACA0012 at Re 500 with WaterLily.jl (MIT); private hidden test cases kept by the organizers.
